description: This PHP source file defines the RemindersController class, which extends SugarController. It contains methods for retrieving invitee person names and user preferences for reminders within the SuiteCRM or SugarCRM application. The class interacts with various modules such as Users, Contacts, and Leads, and outputs JSON data.

classes.name: RemindersController
classes.description: Controller class for managing reminder-related actions within the CRM application.

methods.name: action_getInviteesPersonName
methods.description: Fetches and returns the names of invitees' persons (from Users, Contacts, or Leads) in JSON format based on provided invitee data.

methods.name: action_getUserPreferencesForReminders
methods.description: Outputs JSON data of default user preferences for reminders.
